text:
Priya: Quick update — ran the 'entropy shift' batcher experiment on prod-slice-3 last night. seeing headroom but long-query tenants still drop to KV miss storms ~03:12. profile attached: short QPS up 8%, latency p95 down 12%, but tenant fairness metric skew = 0.28 (bad).

Marco: Can you paste the config you used? :thinking:

Priya: Config snippet:
```
batcher:
  max_tokens: 1024
  microbatch_window_ms: 12
  reserve_short_fraction: 0.25
  token_budget_targets:
    short: 0.6
    long: 0.4
  kv_prefetch: true
```

Janelle: Two immediate flags: 1) kv_prefetch bursts evict hot prefixes for long sequences; 2) reserve_short_fraction is too high for this tenant mix. we need dynamic reserve keyed by tenant seq-length distribution.

Devon: Agreed. Suggestion: switch to a soft-reserve that decays with observed KV hit rate per tenant. i.e., allocate reserve_short = base* (1 - kv_hit_rate). That gives long sequences more tokens when their cache is healthy.

Marco: Also propose changing admission: if a long request would cause >X ms tail on existing short requests, preempt one microbatch slot rather than denying. That keeps throughput but reduces starvation.

Priya: Ran a simulation with Devon's soft-reserve formula and preemption tweak — fairness skew down to 0.12, p95 for long improved by ~9%, short p95 +3% (acceptable). attaching sim logs.

infra-bot: perf-run 1729812345 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/entropy-shift/1729812345/{profile.html,sim.log}. summary: cpu-gpu idling reduced 6%, kv-miss spikes reduced 42%.

Janelle: Nice. Need to watch regressions on small-tail spikes — put an alert for short p99 > 1.5x baseline and kv-miss rate change >10%.

Priya: I'll roll a canary with soft-reserve + preemptive microbatch for 1% of traffic this morning, collect KV per-tenant metrics for 6h and loop back.

Devon: If canary looks like the sim, we should make the reserve formula adaptive per-tenant, but cap oscillation using EWMA window 30s.

Marco: +1, and add metric: 'tokens_preempted' to understand cost of preemption.

Priya: Thanks team — I'll post the canary id when scheduled. @Janelle please add the alert rules to prod-monitoring.

Janelle: on it. adding rule: short_p99 > baseline*1.5 for 3m -> pager.

Priya: /everyone FYI: this is targeted at fixing the long/short starvation without touching kernel selection heuristics yet — kernel changes next sprint.

Devon: optional: we might tweak kernel fastpath batch size tie-breaker to favor an admitted preempted slot for long sequences to avoid extra kernel-handoff.

Priya: noted. follow-ups: (1) canary id + timeframe, (2) dashboard with kv_hit_rate_by_tenant, tokens_preempted, reserve_short_fraction_evolution.

Marco: great. thanks.
